name: card
title: Card
description: The one container for a block of content: a titled section with an optional toolbar, a body and a footer.
whenToUse: Every block on a page. One container per block: never put a framed card inside another card. Tables, filter bars and forms inside a card sit flush (their frame is removed automatically).

variants.description: Title row with optional subtitle and actions on the right.
No padding, for tables that run edge to edge.
Slight gradient and deeper shadow, for hero blocks.
A heading for a group of cards, without a frame.

a11y: Give the card's title an id and set aria-labelledby on the <section>.
